descriptionChirho: A proper noun with the article (הָרָפָה) designating a progenitor of the Rephaim giants, used as a clan identifier for warriors descended from this figure in Philistine contexts (2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles). The two clusters differ only in prepositional attachment and minor transliteration: eng the-Raphah/to-the-Rapha, spa el-Rafa/para-el-rafa, hin रापा-से/रपाह-से, arb לִלרָּפָא/לִלרָּפָא, kor 그-라파/에게-그-르바, swa na-Rafa/kwa-Harafa. All 6 occurrences refer to the same ancestral giant figure.
